articles.title: A Suitcase-Sized Satellite Will Hunt for the Universe's Darkest Era
articles.summary: CosmoCube, a small spacecraft, will orbit the Moon to detect a faint radio signal from the 150 million years before the first stars — a period no telescope has ever directly observed.

articles.title: Earth's Health Check: 7 of 9 Planetary Boundaries Breached, Report Warns
articles.summary: A new report by 60+ scientists finds seven of Earth's nine planetary boundaries — including climate change and ocean acidification — have been breached. But researchers say there's still a window to act.

articles.title: A Shark Graveyard Hidden in Egypt's Desert
articles.summary: Paleontologists uncovered 14 fossilized shark teeth in Egypt's Western Desert, dating back 70 to 80 million years. The now-dry land was once a shallow tropical sea.
